# SOURCE
~~~sysml
package GeometryIndexing {
    private import ScalarValues::*;
    private import ShapeItems::*;
    private import Items::Item;
    private import SequenceFunctions::*;
    constraint def PolygonVertices {
        in polygon : Polygon;
        (1..size(polygon.edges))->forAll { in i;
            polygon.edges#(i).vertices->equals((polygon.vertices#((2*i)-1), polygon.vertices#(2*i))) and
            includes((polygon.edges#(i).vertices#(2) as Item).matingOccurrences,
                polygon.edges#(if i==size(polygon.edges) ? 1 else i+1).vertices#(1))
        }
    }
    constraint def PyramidWalls {
        in pyramid : Pyramid;
        (1..pyramid.wallNumber)->forAll { in i;
            includes(pyramid.wall#(i).base.matingOccurrences, pyramid.base.edges#(i)) and
            includes((pyramid.wall#(i).edges#(3) as Item).matingOccurrences,
                pyramid.wall#(if i==pyramid.wallNumber ? 1 else i+1).edges#(2))
        }
    }
}
~~~
